originals.citation: Grasby, P. M., Frith, C. D., et al. (1993). Functional mapping of brain areas implicated in auditory-verbal memory function. Brain.

quote: These data, obtained using a within-subject design, extend previously reported findings that used mixed within-and between-subject designs and demonstrate important functional components of normal auditoryverbal short-term memory.
notes: Full text not accessible (Wiley 403). Web sources (Brede Wiki summary) state the study sought to replicate Grasby et al. 1993 (list-length verbal memory PET with frontal activation beyond span); one summary also mentions Paulesu 1993 (@paulesu1993), which is less directly the same paradigm.
